stone_quarry.desc: Stone is an excellent construction material used for houses, aqueducts, temples, bridges, and more. Unfortunately, it must be extracted, and high-quality building stone is not always abundant. To meet our needs, we can establish quarries in areas with good-quality material.

printing_press_shop.desc: Utilizing easily produced and replaceable parts the Printers Shop will reduce both our cost in labor and materials to produce and spread written documents among our population.

cannon_maker.name: Cannon Maker
cannon_maker.desc: A guild specialized in crafting and assembling cannons. These powerful weapons are essential for sieges and defense.

cannon_workshop.desc: The ever-increasing demand of artillery for our armies requires us to increase the capabilities of the Cannon production.

cannon_foundry.name: Cannon Foundry
cannon_foundry.desc: In a Cannon Foundry cannons are cast and assembled from molten metal. Key for equipping armies with artillery, enhancing a state's military capabilities.

cannons_factory.name: Cannons Factory
cannons_factory.desc: A large-scale factory where cannons were manufactured in bulk. Its expanded production capacity is a great way to facilitate the growing needs of our military forces.

cloth_guild.name: Spinners' Guild
cloth_guild.desc: The production of various textiles is often a cornerstone of a realm's economy. The Spinners' Guild, which includes dyers, weavers, and fullers, maintains a steady production as well as a set of standards to ensure the quality and volume needed.

cloth_workshop.name: Cloth Workshop
cloth_workshop.desc: Easier methods of cleaning fibers and dedicated workshops for the production of Cloth will increase the output of our textile industries.

cloth_manufactory.name: Textile Manufactory
cloth_manufactory.desc: Cloth represents the various fabrics and clothing made from wool and linen. The Textile Manufactory specializes in the production of Cloth from various materials such as Wool, Cotton and Fiber Crops.

textile_mill.name: Textile Mill
textile_mill.desc: Powered by Waterwheels, a Textile Mill can mass-produce Cloth at rapid speed.

dyes_guild.name: Dye Maker
dyes_guild.desc: For as long as textiles have been woven there has been a market for fine Dyes. The Dye Maker creates Dyes from available plants.

dyes_workshop.name: Dyes Workshop
dyes_workshop.desc: Dyes and pigments can be created from a variety of sources, but they need to be processed in a certain manner, usually only known to a selected people.

dyesworks.name: Dyesworks
dyesworks.desc: A dedicated and expanded dyes production will ensure that our population gets access to as much variety of pigments and colors as they desire.

dyes_mill.name: Dyes Mill
dyes_mill.desc: Only by extensive manufactories dedicated to the production of various dyes, will we be able to satisfy the increasing need for pigments and fancy colors.

fine_cloth_guild.name: Tailors' Guild
fine_cloth_guild.desc: The need for luxury textiles such as finely-woven Wool, silk, and velvet, is a lucrative business that often involves the aristocracy. Developing advanced techniques for weaving and finishing fabrics, these centers of innovation often contribute greatly to local and state economies.

fine_cloth_workshop.name: Fine Cloth Workshop
fine_cloth_workshop.desc: Easier methods of cleaning fibers and dedicated workshops for the production of Fine Cloth will increase the output of our textile industries.

fine_cloth_manufactory.name: Fine Cloth Manufactory
fine_cloth_manufactory.desc: Fine Cloth is traditionally a marker of status for the elites and wealthy classes. The Fine Cloth Manufactory focuses on the crafting of these valuable textiles using Cloth or Silk.

fine_cloth_mill.name: Fine Cloth Mill
fine_cloth_mill.desc: Powered by Waterwheels, a Fine Cloth Mill can mass-produce Fine Cloth at rapid speed.

hand_cannon_guild.name: Hand Cannon Guild

guns_workshop.name: Guns Workshop
guns_workshop.desc: The ever-increasing demand of guns for our armies requires us to increase the capabilities of the Firearms production.

firearms_manufactory.name: Firearms Manufactory
firearms_manufactory.desc: Often described as the lifeblood of our military production complex, the Firearms Manufactory produces firearms of many shapes and sizes such as pistols, rifles, and more.

firearms_factory.name: Firearms Factory
firearms_factory.desc: The rising demands of protecting our borders come with an increase in the production and demand quotas from our military production complex. This need is met by the Firearms Factory where large quantities of guns are made.

furniture_guild.desc: Carpentry is one of the most basic activities for supporting a household. Organizing into guilds allows carpenters to establish standards and share techniques that facilitate the sustainability of their work.

furniture_workshop.name: Furniture Workshop
furniture_workshop.desc: With the rising wealth of our burghers so rises their demand for goods like Furniture. Shifting the production into larger workshops will ensure more Furniture can be produced.

furniture_mill.desc: Rising social wealth generates a growing demand for manufactured goods such as furniture. The only way to continue increasing supply may be to produce them in factories using industrial methods.

glassworks.desc: Refinement of traditional Glassblowing techniques and the addition of new materials make it easier to mass-produce Glass.

glass_mill.name: Glass Mill
glass_mill.desc: Dedicated Glass Mill industries will be able to increase our production of Glass further than ever before. By rolling molten glass on iron tables, we will not only be able to increase the size of our produced Glass but also significantly speed up the manufacturing process.

lacquerware_guild.name: Lacquerware Artisans' Guild
lacquerware_guild.desc: Combining sap from lacquer trees in multiple layers, gives the produced items their signature glossy finish, in a Lacquerware Artisans' Guild. Such sought-after high quality items include furniture, ceremonial boxes, and more. Lacquerware is highly valued for its beauty and resilience.

lacquerware_manufactory.name: Lacquerware Manufactory
lacquerware_manufactory.desc: Refinements of the process of painting and applying the lacquer make Lacquerware cheaper and quicker to produce.

tannery.name: Tannery
tannery.desc: Responsible for the production of leather, the Tannery produces important items such as shoes, saddles, and book bindings. Utilizing advanced techniques to manipulate animal hides, the tanner ensures the durability as well as aestheticism of Leather.

tanning_workshop.name: Tanning Workshop
tanning_workshop.desc: The production of Leather has refined and allows for a wider scope of produced hide materials and increased output.

tannery_manufactory.name: Tanning Manufactory
tannery_manufactory.desc: Advancements in chemistry make the process of tanning animal hides significantly shorter and produce higher quality Leather

tannery_mill.name: Tannery Mill
tannery_mill.desc: With the use of new chemicals and more efficient production methods, our Leather production will be unrivaled.

distillers_guild.name: Distillers' Guild
distillers_guild.desc: This brotherhood of Distillers controls the secrets and manufactory of any distilled goods in the town. All that want to learn that trade are forced to join them and expand their monopoly.

distillers_workshop.name: Distillers Workshop
distillers_workshop.desc: By distilling in larger workshops with ample storage for aging, we will be able to produce larger quantities of alcoholic drinks.

distiller_manufactory.name: Liquor Manufactory
distiller_manufactory.desc: A center of production where the secrecy of an old time guild is drowned by the great demand for increased amounts of distilled goods. This need has shaped a new and modern system of production that prioritizes quantity and profit.

distiller_mill.name: Distiller Mill
distiller_mill.desc: Large Distilleries will be able to utilize steam powered engines and automatized mechanism to increase the output of their facilities.

naval_supplies_guild.name: Naval Supplies Guild
naval_supplies_guild.desc: Naval Supplies represent everything needed in ship construction, from basic wood to tar, ropes, linen, sails, and various other materials. While a vast and diverse trade good, the Naval Supplies Guild covers all the materials needed for ship building.

naval_supplies_workshop.name: Naval Supplies Workshop
naval_supplies_workshop.desc: Naval Supplies play a vital role in the supply and upkeep of our maritime ambitions. With bigger production spaces we will be able to maintain our position and increase our output.

naval_supplies_manufactory.name: Naval Supplies Manufactory
naval_supplies_manufactory.desc: Similar to the Naval Supplies Guild, so does the Naval Supplies Manufactory focus on the production of Naval Supplies. Thanks to its increased dimensions, the output of available supplies for the ship construction is significantly higher.

naval_supplies_mill.name: Naval Supplies Mill
naval_supplies_mill.desc: The steady increase in trading across the globe requires more Naval Supplies than ever before and dedicated mills are required to supply it.

paper_guild.name: Papermakers' Guild
paper_guild.desc: Paper is the cornerstone of every realm, as it is used in every aspect of it, from administration to education and even trade. Thus, the Papermakers' Guild ensures the proper standard of production and volume, as well as a unique technique that involves the soaking, pulping or pressing of basic supplies such as linen, cotton or other plant fibers.

paper_workshop.name: Paper Workshop
paper_workshop.desc: Paper is a necessity for all types of advanced accounting, administration, and diffusion of knowledge. The Paper Workshop specializes in the creation of new Paper with lump, Fiber Crops and Lumber.

paper_manufactory.name: Paper Manufactory
paper_manufactory.desc: The increasing demand for Paper due to the printing industry forces innovative methods to up the production of Paper as well.

paper_mill.name: Paper Mill
paper_mill.desc: Utilizing Cloth made from Cotton, a Paper Mill will be able to produce higher quantities of paper.

porcelain_guild.name: Porcelain Kiln
porcelain_guild.desc: Porcelain is a type of ceramics characterized by its strength and translucence due to the vitrification of the materials caused by high temperatures. The Porcelain Kiln specializes in the creation and decoration of such wares.

porcelain_manufactory.name: Porcelain Manufactory
porcelain_manufactory.desc: The production of Porcelain is the result of long alchemical experiments, allowing an alternative to the expensive import from overseas.

pottery_guild.name: Potters' Guild
pottery_guild.desc: Pottery making is one of humanity's oldest economic activities. The association of potters in guilds fosters the exchange of knowledge and the specialization of work, allowing for greater ceramic production.

pottery_workshop.name: Pottery Workshop
pottery_workshop.desc: Pottery is a staple in all population, from simple storage vessels to ornamentation objects. Streamlining its production in specialized workshops will serve to satisfy the people's need for pottery.

pottery_manufactory.name: Pottery Manufactory
pottery_manufactory.desc: The growing demand for commercialized ceramics has led to the creation of economies of scale. The production of manufactured goods using a common, organized workflow, renders pottery-making no longer a craft profession.

pottery_mill.name: Pottery Mill
pottery_mill.desc: The growth in the supply generated by manufactured ceramics has led to its ultimate logical consequence: the development of mass production, in which industrial workers are now responsible for producing the ceramics.

saltpeter_guild.name: Saltpeter Guild
saltpeter_guild.desc: Produced through a labor-intensive process, Saltpeter is vital for the production of gunpowder, and thus state defense. It is extracted from nitrate-rich soils as well as manure or decaying organic matter.

saltpeter_workshop.name: Saltpeter Workshop
saltpeter_workshop.desc: With the increasing demand for gunpowder by our forces, a reliable production of artificial Saltpeter is a necessity.

putrefaction_works.name: Putrefaction Works
putrefaction_works.desc: Saltpeter is a valuable chemical compound which finds its uses as a fertilizer, salt for meat processing and as key ingredient for gunpowder. The Putrefaction Works serves as an alternative way to gain Saltpeter for cases where mining operations are not available.

putrefaction_mill.name: Putrefaction Mill
putrefaction_mill.desc: By increasing the quantity of our boilers for the process of concentrating the Saltpeter and improving their reliability, we will be able to increase the production of gunpowder for our troops without the reliance on costly imports.

tools_guild.name: Tools Guild
tools_guild.desc: Be it from the simple hammer to the first machine tools; Tools have been always a major part of our society. The Tools Guild specializes in producing these handy devices.

tools_workshop.name: Tools Workshop
tools_workshop.desc: With the expanding of our economy, no longer can our people rely on artisan-made tools. The establishment of proper workshops for the production of tools for our population and business has become a necessity.

iron_foundry.name: Iron Foundry
iron_foundry.desc: Tools made from Iron will be sturdier than any other known production while not requiring the same time-consuming crafting process.

iron_mill.name: Iron Mill
iron_mill.desc: Utilizing blast furnaces, the Iron Mill will produce Tools at much higher quantity than any other method available.

weapon_guild.name: Weaponsmith
weapon_guild.desc: An association of craftsmen responsible for the production of various weapons, guilds such as this are a pillar for state defense, supplying the common soldier with arms tailored to specific martial needs and volume.

weapon_workshop.name: Weapon Workshop
weapon_workshop.desc: The ever-increasing demand of weapons both for our armies and our hunting operations requires us to increase the capabilities of the Weaponry production.

weapon_manufactory.name: Weaponry Manufactory
weapon_manufactory.desc: Various weapons such as swords, pikes, and bows make up the core Weaponry of every army. Using various materials, the Weaponry Manufactory creates melee and simple ranged weapons of all types.

weapon_factory.name: Weapon Mill
weapon_factory.desc: Military importance has increased much more in recent years. As such, better and new methods of producing armament for our soldiers are needed, and entire factories dedicated for such purpose are being established.

winery.name: Winery
winery.desc: A humble guild where various raw sugars are fermented into rich and intoxicating beverages. Though simpler than traditional grape wine, these drinks are enjoyed by commoners and nobles alike, each region perfecting its own distinct flavors and techniques.

winery_manufactory.name: Winery Manufactory
winery_manufactory.desc: The ever-growing demand for refined fermented drinks has led to the creation of vast production centers where tradition meets industry. Ancient methods of wines are scaled up to serve bustling cities and far-reaching trade networks, ensuring no cup is left empty.

apothecary.name: Apothecary
apothecary.desc: An apothecary is a place where medicines can be found and dispensed. These come from a variety of sources, including herbs and other natural remedies, but also from more exotic materials, such as animal horns or mercury.

jewelry_guild.name: Jewelers' Guild
jewelry_guild.desc: The manipulation of gems, and valuable stones into jewels of the highest quality, makes the Jewelers' Guild a sought-after occupation due to its perceived profit.

steel_mill.name: Steel Mill
steel_mill.desc: An increase in the reliability of our furnaces and production process made it possible to produce Steel on an economically beneficial scale.

perfumery.name: Perfumery
perfumery.desc: Cultivating flowers and extracting their essence, the Perfumery produces a luxury good for the wealthy.

monastery.name: Monastery
monastery.desc: A place for seclusion and contemplation, monasteries are a refuge for those that want to dedicate their lives to communion with the heavens. Their grounds are thus for study and reflection, and great knowledge is usually guarded behind their walls.

charcoal_maker.name: Charcoal Kiln
charcoal_maker.desc: Charcoal is burned to heat our homes and fuel our forges. By burning the plentiful wood available to us, we can produce charcoal, which generates more heat than the wood does in its raw form.

improved_charcoal_maker.name: Charcoal Burner
improved_charcoal_maker.desc: Improvements to the Charcoal Burning process allow us to output greater quantities and have a more efficient conversion rate.

elephant_hunting_grounds.name: Elephant Hunting Grounds
elephant_hunting_grounds.desc: Due to their size, elephants cannot simply be bred on regular farms like horses or cows. Instead, we will establish elephant hunting grounds, which will function as semi-wild farms, allowing us to select those elephants that best meet our needs.

windmill.desc: Windmills come in various shape and sizes, as well as diverse sails structure and mechanisms, but they all serve to harness the power of wind to crush grain. As a result, the nutritious value of crops can be greatly improved, and transformed into a wider range of prepared foods.

local_smelters.desc: Mother Earth is abundant in metal resources, but little can be done with them unless they are smelted first. As such, smelters tend to be established near where the metals are extracted, to prepare them for easier transportation and further processing elsewhere.
